design.stratified: one random grid chunk per equal-width stratum of the 30d span
design.ci: 95% bootstrap over sampled chunks (stratification ignored, so slightly conservative)

top50SenderBurnShare.note: top-50 chosen inside the sample; see caveats

loopBurnRunsGE10MON.note: runs truncated at 1h chunk edges: lower bound

design.sampling: uniform over failed txs within 30 stratified 1h chunks; burn shares are ratio estimates weighted by each row's burnWei
design.resim: eth_estimateGas at the parent block; when the tx reverts there, gas-to-revert bisected with eth_call to 1% (upper bound, so gasLimit/resim is slightly understated)

hardcodedGasProxy.definition: failed tx whose gasLimit >= 2x its re-simulated gas at the parent block

replayAtParentBlock.note: side observation only; the knowable-at-N-k benchmark is a separate work item and uses N-1/N-2/N-3
